title: Madongo Dumplings
description: Madongo Dumplings is a dish from Saint Vincent and the Grenadines featuring arrowroot tuber, cassava root, coconut milk. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Arrowroot tuber provides a home approximation; the exact traditional madongo starch and binding vary by island.

steps.instruction: Peel and coarsely grate the listed vegetables; squeeze out excess moisture so the mixture will hold together.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Shape the arrowroot-cassava mixture into compact dumplings with damp hands; no filling is needed.
Cook dumplings in batches in gently boiling salted water for about 23 minutes, until they float and the filling is cooked through. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
